iast: saṅkalpa ūrdhvam eva gacchati, na svayaṃ kriyate
devanagari: सङ्कल्प ऊर्ध्वम् एव गच्छति, न स्वयं क्रियते
english: Intent goes only upward; it is never itself enacted (the Rocha cut).

iast: sandeśaḥ preṣakotpanna-kuñcikayā mudritaḥ
devanagari: सन्देशः प्रेषकोत्पन्नकुञ्चिकया मुद्रितः
english: A message is signed by a key derived from its own sender, never the shared master key.

iast: paṭṭaḥ krama-vardhamāna-yugena yuktaḥ, avadhiṃ prāpya samāpyate
devanagari: पट्टः क्रमवर्धमानयुगेन युक्तः, अवधिं प्राप्य समाप्यते
english: A lease is bound to a monotonically increasing epoch and ends upon reaching its expiry.

iast: navīnaḥ samanvayakaḥ sthāyi-lekhāt yugāni bījayati
devanagari: नवीनः समन्वयकः स्थायिलेखात् युगानि बीजयति
english: A fresh coordinator seeds its epochs from the durable log, never from zero.

iast: ajñātam ārogyaṃ sāvadhānam eva
devanagari: अज्ञातम् आरोग्यं सावधानम् एव
english: Unknown health is itself an andon; it is never silently treated as green.

iast: argalā parīkṣyate, na kadāpi kalpyate
devanagari: अर्गला परीक्ष्यते, न कदापि कल्प्यते
english: The interlock is examined; it is never merely presumed locked.

iast: paryavekṣaṇaṃ satyaṃ jīva-saṅketam eva dadāti
devanagari: पर्यवेक्षणं सत्यं जीवसङ्केतम् एव ददाति
english: Supervision gives back the real living pid, nothing else, so it can actually supervise.

iast: racanā-prakārāḥ kevalaṃ racanā-pramāṇāt āyānti
devanagari: रचनाप्रकाराः केवलं रचनाप्रमाणात् आयान्ति
english: Design kinds come only from the design authority, never from a runtime tier.

iast: pratyaṃśaḥ pūrṇavat, sarvāsu bhūmiṣu samam eva mukhaṃ darśayati
devanagari: प्रत्यंशः पूर्णवत्, सर्वासु भूमिषु समम् एव मुखं दर्शयति
english: Every part is like the whole: at every level it shows the very same interface.

iast: pūrṇāṃśa-tantram acakram, bhūmi-krameṇa eva vardhate
devanagari: पूर्णांशतन्त्रम् अचक्रम्, भूमिक्रमेण एव वर्धते
english: The whole-part system (holarchy) is acyclic; it grows only in level order.

iast: kathitaṃ pramāṇaṃ na grāhyam
devanagari: कथितं प्रमाणं न ग्राह्यम्
english: A merely-declared proof is not admissible; declaration is not evidence.

iast: sūcī gaṇyate na, parīkṣyate eva
devanagari: सूची गण्यते न, परीक्ष्यते एव
english: The checklist is not counted; it is evaluated, item by item.

iast: prativiṣayaṃ sapta-daśa-nirṇayāḥ sarve dīyante
devanagari: प्रतिविषयं सप्तदशनिर्णयाः सर्वे दीयन्ते
english: To every subject, all seventeen verdicts are given.

iast: yaḥ viṣayaḥ aparīkṣyaḥ, tasya parīkṣā-sāpekṣa-pakṣāḥ sīdanti
devanagari: यः विषयः अपरीक्ष्यः, तस्य परीक्षासापेक्षपक्षाः सीदन्ति
english: A subject that cannot be probed — its probe-dependent aspects fail closed.

iast: pravṛtti-niyantraṇasya mūlyaṃ śūnyāṅkaiḥ eva
devanagari: प्रवृत्तिनियन्त्रणस्य मूल्यं शून्याङ्कैः एव
english: The cost of runtime control is zero tokens, nothing more.

iast: cakram avalokana-vicāra-nirṇaya-kriyā-krameṇa niyata-mūlyena baddham
devanagari: चक्रम् अवलोकनविचारनिर्णयक्रियाक्रमेण नियतमूल्येन बद्धम्
english: The cycle — observe, orient, decide, act, in that order — is bound to a fixed budget.

iast: asaphalaḥ saṃyoga uttara-cakre sāvadhānaṃ janayati
devanagari: असफलः संयोग उत्तरचक्रे सावधानं जनयति
english: A failed reconcile produces an andon on the following cycle.

iast: prathamāyāṃ anujñā-nirākaraṇāyāṃ sandeśa-preṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhati
devanagari: प्रथमायां अनुज्ञानिराकरणायां सन्देशप्रेषणं तिष्ठति
english: At the first authorization refusal, posting stops.

iast: doṣe dṛṣṭe, svataḥ-yantraṃ paṅktim avasthāpayati
devanagari: दोषे दृष्टे, स्वतःयन्त्रं पङ्क्तिम् अवस्थापयति
english: When a defect is seen, the self-acting mechanism (jidoka) stops the line.

iast: pravartamāna-kāryāṇāṃ saṅkhyā kāṣṭha-paṭṭikā-sīmayā baddhā
devanagari: प्रवर्तमानकार्याणां सङ्ख्या काष्ठपट्टिकासीमया बद्धा
english: The count of work-in-progress is bound by the kanban board's limit.

iast: gati-mānaṃ paṅktiṃ niyacchati, na kartuḥ utsāham
devanagari: गतिमानं पङ्क्तिं नियच्छति, न कर्तुः उत्साहम्
english: Takt time governs the line's pace, not the worker's ambition.

iast: preṣaka-śṛṅkhalāḥ kevalam āpūryante, na kadāpi luptāḥ
devanagari: प्रेषकशृङ्खलाः केवलम् आपूर्यन्ते, न कदापि लुप्ताः
english: Per-sender chains are only ever appended to; they are never truncated.

iast: naṣṭa-sandeśasya uttare kāraṇa-vyavadhāna-lekhaḥ āvaśyakaḥ
devanagari: नष्टसन्देशस्य उत्तरे कारणव्यवधानलेखः आवश्यकः
english: A reply to a lost message needs an explicit causal-gap record.

iast: vinā satya-vahana-svīkāreṇa na kiñcit "prāptam" iti likhyate
devanagari: विना सत्यवहनस्वीकारेण न किञ्चित् "प्राप्तम्" इति लिख्यते
english: Without a real transport acknowledgement, nothing is ever written as delivered.

iast: smṛtiḥ anujñā-dvāreṇa eva, svāminaiva likhyate
devanagari: स्मृतिः अनुज्ञाद्वारेण एव, स्वामिनैव लिख्यते
english: Memory is grant-gated: reachable only through a live grant, and written only by its owner.

iast: sāmarthyānujñā kṣetra-baddhā, avadhim atikramya na tiṣṭhati
devanagari: सामर्थ्यानुज्ञा क्षेत्रबद्धा, अवधिम् अतिक्रम्य न तिष्ठति
english: A capability grant is bound to its scope; past its expiry it no longer stands.

iast: sādhāraṇaṃ kuñcikā-kṣetraṃ na kadāpi vilupyate
devanagari: साधारणं कुञ्चिकाक्षेत्रं न कदापि विलुप्यते
english: A shared key space is never deleted (SYNC-05).

iast: lekhasya para-paṅktiḥ pūrvāṃ na hanti, kevalam atikrāmati
devanagari: लेखस्य परपङ्क्तिः पूर्वां न हन्ति, केवलम् अतिक्रामति
english: The ledger's later line does not kill the earlier one; it only supersedes it.

iast: mārga-nirṇayaḥ pratyekaṃ phalaka-sandeśaḥ eva
devanagari: मार्गनिर्णयः प्रत्येकं फलकसन्देशः एव
english: Every routing decision is itself a board message.

iast: prathamaṃ niḥśulkaṃ gṛhyate, mūlya-nikṛṣṭaṃ dvi-paisā-mātram
devanagari: प्रथमं निःशुल्कं गृह्यते, मूल्यनिकृष्टं द्विपैसामात्रम्
english: The free tier is taken first; the paid floor is at most USD 0.02.

iast: sīmām atikramituṃ pūrvaṃ praśnaḥ śodhana-parīkṣāṃ tarati
devanagari: सीमाम् अतिक्रमितुं पूर्वं प्रश्नः शोधनपरीक्षां तरति
english: Before it crosses the boundary, a prompt must pass the sanitize check.

iast: svīkāraḥ nirdeśaḥ vahanaṃ ca kāryaṃ na kadāpi anujānanti
devanagari: स्वीकारः निर्देशः वहनं च कार्यं न कदापि अनुजानन्ति
english: An acknowledgement, a reference, or a transport projection never themselves authorize an effect.

iast: eka-saṅketaḥ ekaṃ karma nirdiśati, viruddhe punaḥ-prayoge doṣaḥ jāyate
devanagari: एकसङ्केतः एकं कर्म निर्दिशति, विरुद्धे पुनःप्रयोगे दोषः जायते
english: One operation id names one command; a conflicting reuse of it is an error.

iast: mṛta-pāṇi-yantraṃ maunaṃ jīrṇam iti lakṣayati, na ārogyam
devanagari: मृतपाणियन्त्रं मौनं जीर्णम् इति लक्षयति, न आरोग्यम्
english: The dead-man's-switch marks silence as stale; it never mistakes silence for health.

iast: eka-yantra-phalaṃ vā sakhi-svīkāro vā svataḥ niyoga-sāmarthyaṃ na dadāti
devanagari: एकयन्त्रफलं वा सखिस्वीकारो वा स्वतः नियोगसामर्थ्यं न ददाति
english: Neither one model's result nor a peer's acknowledgement alone grants deployment authority.

iast: vikāsaḥ kevalaṃ parīkṣita-yogyatām eva svīkaroti
devanagari: विकासः केवलं परीक्षितयोग्यताम् एव स्वीकरोति
english: Evolution adopts only fitness that has been verified, never a self-claimed score.

iast: svapna-cakraṃ paṅktau niṣkriyāyām eva pravartate
devanagari: स्वप्नचक्रं पङ्क्तौ निष्क्रियायाम् एव प्रवर्तते
english: The dream cycle (svapna) runs only when the line is idle.

iast: svapnaḥ vikalpān janayati, na kadāpi siddha-vastūni
devanagari: स्वप्नः विकल्पान् जनयति, न कदापि सिद्धवस्तूनि
english: The dream produces hypotheses (vikalpa), never established facts.

iast: vikalpaḥ śūnyāt ekasmāt madhye niścayena eva gṛhyate, na jñānam iti
devanagari: विकल्पः शून्यात् एकस्मात् मध्ये निश्चयेन एव गृह्यते, न ज्ञानम् इति
english: A hypothesis is admitted only with a confidence strictly between zero and one, never as knowledge.

iast: matam kevalaṃ parīkṣita-phalebhyaḥ vardhate, na svayaṃ-kathanāt
devanagari: मतम् केवलं परीक्षितफलेभ्यः वर्धते, न स्वयंकथनात्
english: Belief grows only from verified outcomes, never from self-report.

iast: sarvebhyo alpa-mūlyaḥ yogyaḥ stara eva vṛtaḥ, na su-vāgmī
devanagari: सर्वेभ्यो अल्पमूल्यः योग्यः स्तर एव वृतः, न सुवाग्मी
english: Of all tiers, the cheapest adequate one alone is chosen, never the most eloquent.

iast: unnayanam ekaṃ padam eva, dvitīye vibhrame mūlādhikāriṇe svataḥ-yantra-nirodhaḥ
devanagari: उन्नयनम् एकं पदम् एव, द्वितीये विभ्रमे मूलाधिकारिणे स्वतःयन्त्रनिरोधः
english: Escalation is one step only; a second failure is a jidoka stop for the root (L0) authority.

iast: prativākyaṃ sādhāraṇa-śabdakośena badhyate, anyathā svataḥ ruddhyate
devanagari: प्रतिवाक्यं साधारणशब्दकोशेन बध्यते, अन्यथा स्वतः रुध्यते
english: Every utterance binds to the shared vocabulary, otherwise it fails closed by itself.

iast: prārthanā vā prastāvo vā iṣṭi-vākyaṃ tasmāt-vākyaṃ vā vahati
devanagari: प्रार्थना वा प्रस्तावो वा इष्टिवाक्यं तस्मात्वाक्यं वा वहति
english: A REQUEST or a PROPOSE carries an intention clause or a therefore clause.

iast: sūcanā vā pratijñā vā jñāna-vākyam eva vahati
devanagari: सूचना वा प्रतिज्ञा वा ज्ञानवाक्यम् एव वहति
english: An INFORM or an ASSERT carries only a knowledge clause.

iast: sāvadhānena niyantraṇa-kriyāyāḥ nāma avaśyam eva ucyate
devanagari: सावधानेन नियन्त्रणक्रियायाः नाम अवश्यम् एव उच्यते
english: An ANDON must always name the control action it concerns.

iast: mūla-rūpaṃ dvi-bhāṣam: saṃskṛtaṃ pūrvam, āṅglaṃ prati-paṅkti sahacaram
devanagari: मूलरूपं द्विभाषम्: संस्कृतं पूर्वम्, आङ्ग्लं प्रतिपङ्क्ति सहचरम्
english: The canonical form is bilingual: Sanskrit first, English a companion beside every line.

iast: āṅglam iyad vā saṃskṛtam vā devanāgarī vā, ekam eva vākyaṃ nirdiśati
devanagari: आङ्ग्लम् इयद् वा संस्कृतम् वा देवनागरी वा, एकम् एव वाक्यं निर्दिशति
english: Whether English, IAST, or Devanagari — every surface form parses to the same utterance.

iast: lekhanaṃ paṭhanaṃ ca yuktam, mūla-rūpam eva punaḥ dadāti
devanagari: लेखनं पठनं च युक्तम्, मूलरूपम् एव पुनः ददाति
english: Writing and reading, composed together, give back only the original form again (roundtrip).
